ألتقط (form VIII)
# أَلْتَقِطُ (ʔaltaqiṭu) /ʔal.ta.qi.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# أُلْتَقَطُ (ʔultaqaṭu) /ʔul.ta.qa.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# أَلْتَقِطَ (ʔaltaqiṭa) /ʔal.ta.qi.tˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# أُلْتَقَطَ (ʔultaqaṭa) /ʔul.ta
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
